named_changes.name: lopdf 0.47: two blank pages recovered

Those streams hold inline images; page 37's declares /CS [/I /RGB ...], the shape upstream #597 accepts, so #597 is the likely fix, not separately bisected. Under 0.47 they parse: 79 and 65 words against PyMuPDF's 78 and 70. Recall 0.9036 -> 0.9067. Read the page and text diffs: new text only.

named_changes.name: lopdf 0.47: last 143 operations of a figure panel parsed
named_changes.reason: Form Im5 on page 3 stopped parsing after 2116 of 2259 operations under 0.45. The extra content moves how this figure's text is structured: 10 false h4 headings made from speech-bubble text go away (headings_kept 0.8, an improvement), and a false table of the same text appears (tables_kept 0.7873, a defect). A garbled 14-glyph line also appears: it is 'Issue Reporter' in a font with no ToUnicode and per-glyph /ActualText, which distillPDF does not read. md_recall and html_recall rise; order holds. Accepted because neither version of this figure's structure was right and fuller content is what the move brings.
